reviews.title: Good SSD drives for the price!
reviews.comment: These Gigastone SSD cards are really great. Prices have gone up on a lot of computer equipment recently and this 2 pack of 2TB gaming SSD's was perfect for my application. The price was still more affordable than buying 1x 4TB SSD and I was able to upgrade 2 laptops rather quick and easy without any issues. The SSD's were formatted to be recognized right away through plug and play, they fit in my HP Envy without issue and they seem faster than my primary SSD that is installed in the laptop, loading games faster and making life so much more simpler giving me extra space to save other media and games for a decent price. Compared to other higher name brands, these work very well and I've had no issues with these drives in either computer that I've installed them. I did reformat them in each laptop prior to utilizing them and reassigned a drive letter to them to make it easier to determine which SSD I want to use as a primary save point for game downloads and other media. Compatibility with Windows 11 OS, runs flawlessly so far and I am satisfied with how it works versus higher end name brands that are nearly double the cost. One thing is for certain, it works and I can't complain that the drive was recognized with ease making my life 100% easier when setting it up.
